method: After freezing the pair, returned to the official 2026–2027 timetable and course entry descriptions. Rebuilt the credits and checked degree progress, then rechecked actual UCR course content, offerings and the finished alignment and audience fields. Same AI.
findings: The regular Dutch part-time BSc totals 180 EC. Twenty-two compulsory 5 EC subject courses give 110 EC; Basic Academic Skills (5 EC), Methods and Techniques of Research (15 EC) and its sequel (5 EC) give 25 EC; the six free slots total 30 EC; the thesis is 15 EC. Seven thematic learning lines organize the same degree, with no separate routes. The annual schedule’s table and official course listings identify MB2512 and MB2212 despite stale footnote codes MB2502 and MB2202.

In the illustrative six-year sequence, MB0622 is taken in year one. The year-three MB0226 needs at least 30 EC including MB0622. Year-five MB2212 follows MB0226, and the year-six 15 EC thesis needs at least 150 EC including MB0226. The 60 EC foundation certificate requires Management and Organization, Entrepreneurship and 50 additional eligible subject or skills credits, excluding free electives. Mandatory in-person meetings in MB0226 are course obligations within its credits.

The broad option combines venture and product design, marketing, accounting, finance, legal context, strategy and organizational behavior. Sustainability governance supplies specific policy and stakeholder context for business decisions in place of the early-only delta project. The finance option retains accounting, money and banking, economics, behavioral economics and econometrics, with statistics, data science and machine learning; Python provides a stronger methods foundation than the broad business AI overview. The transition option combines business foundations and product design with circular operations, sustainable farming and energy, environmental justice, negotiation, climate communication and policy. Resource recovery and material design supply technical understanding of circular production, while the policy course supports regulatory and implementation decisions. Marketing and consumer study are already substantial in the broad option; a fourth marketing and supply-chain plan would largely repeat it. Life-cycle and circular operations evidence cannot substitute for the comparator’s dedicated supply-chain logistics and resilience sequence. Organizational psychology and leadership cover motivation and people management in part, while consulting, dedicated HRM and sustainable finance remain visible gaps. Optional UCR independent research is separate from scheduled credit.
